title: High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2018
short_title: High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would establish a High Speed Rail Planning Authority to advise on and plan an east coast rail network and help reserve its corridor.

The authority would have eleven members, including representatives nominated by participating jurisdictions, local government and the railway industry, alongside members appointed for relevant expertise.
Its work would include land use planning and consultation with interested organisations and the public, and commencement would depend on a budget appropriation for its operation.
changes: A statutory authority would be created with powers needed to perform its rail planning functions.
Authority members would be appointed for three-year terms.
The minister would gain power to make rules for the new framework.
summary.affected: Nominating state and territory governments, local government and railway industry organisations, and people consulted on rail planning are affected.
